assertions.name: h2_concrete_test_completed
assertions.source: Concrete test of whether Bring color-tube `1/(1 − h·q^10)` reproduces canonical + Yekutieli at h² order. Passes iff the leading h² coefficient matches either Family A (3/4) or canonical+Yekutieli (3/4 − G).

description: Concrete test per 2026-05-23-lambda-scale-canonical-unification.md §'Concrete test': symbolic h-expansion of `1/(1 − h_q · q_0^10)` around h = 0 (with q = (h + √(h²+4))/2). Compares h² coefficient to canonical Family A `3/4` and to canonical + Yekutieli additive `3/4 − G`. Reports h⁴ coefficient as concrete target for Option A h⁴ categorical derivation. Informs whether Path C (Bring color-tube) IS the resummed Path B (additive Yekutieli) at leading order.

data.conclusion: PATH C and PATH B are CATEGORICALLY DISTINCT mechanisms at leading h² order. The Bring color-tube h² coefficient does NOT equal (3/4 − G); the two mechanisms cannot be unified by the simple 'resummed Yekutieli' hypothesis.
